_note: ElevenLabs eleven_text_to_sound_v2 prompts for every character / generic effect (sfx-v2, 2026-11-07). duration_s is the requested length; prompt_influence 0.55 everywhere; 2 variations per effect, takes in gens.tsv, the pick per effect in qa-sfx-v2.json (master_sfx.py).

sad-select.prompt: Longsword drawn from a leather scabbard, rising metallic scrape ending in a clean bright ringing blade tone, close-mic

sad-move.prompt: Two heavy armoured footsteps with plate metal clink, steady and deliberate, on stone

sad-capture.prompt: Heavy sword swing whoosh into a solid metal-on-armour strike, bright steel ring, holy shimmer tail

sad-skill.prompt: Holy magic invocation: swelling warm major chord with rising sparkling shimmer, then a bright radiant strike at the end

marki-select.prompt: Big animal snort and a heavy hoof stamp on dirt, close

marki-move.prompt: Two heavy galloping hoof beats on hard ground, low thuds with dust

marki-capture.prompt: Thundering charge into a crunching heavy body-slam impact, deep thud with debris

marki-skill.prompt: Beast charge: a snort, then an accelerating stampede of hooves with a rising rumble

walk-select.prompt: Short wooden shield thump, a round shield hoisted and knocked once, dry

walk-move.prompt: Two quick boot steps with light chainmail jingle on gravel

walk-capture.prompt: Fast spear thrust whoosh into a solid shield-bash impact, metallic knock

walk-skill.prompt: Shield wall: heavy shield slams down with a deep metallic boom and a short resonant ring

insaner-select.prompt: Small demonic cackle giggle with a crackle of magic fire, cartoon villain

insaner-move.prompt: Quick imp hop: a short fiery whoosh with a tiny magical sparkle on landing

insaner-capture.prompt: Demonic fire burst engulfing a target, fiery whoosh with a low growl and crackling embers

insaner-skill.prompt: Magic absorb: a reversed sucking whoosh pulling inward, a rising warbling tone and a closing wet gulp pop

insaner-chain.prompt: Rapid chain of three fiery magical zips rising in pitch, each with a sparkle, quick and playful

death.prompt: A stone statue shatters and disintegrates: short crack, crumbling grains thinning out, a falling tone and dust sparkle

brutile-select.prompt: Dark witch chime: an eerie dissonant bell tone with a cloak swish and a faint poison hiss

brutile-move.prompt: A cloak swish with a hushed dark magical whoosh, low and soft

brutile-capture.prompt: Curse blast: sucking whoosh, a sizzling green-fire burst and a low dark boom with a dissonant sting

brutile-skill.prompt: Wasteland curse cast: rising dark choir hum and drone, a ground crack at the climax, then bubbling poison

waste-death.prompt: A body dissolving in acid poison: sharp acid hiss, thick bubbling, a falling gurgle

michelle-select.prompt: Three slow slightly detuned music box notes, a falling minor melody, and a faint rubber doll squeak

michelle-move.prompt: Two tiny soft footsteps and a faint dress rustle, very quiet, no metal

michelle-capture.prompt: Scissor snip: two sharp scissor blade clicks, a muffled cloth thump and a single music box note sinking flat

michelle-trap-set.prompt: A wind-up toy being set: four ratchet clicks slowing down, a creaky spring settles, then one soft music box note

michelle-trap-sprung.prompt: Toy trap snaps shut: sharp wooden snap, a string pulled tight with a rising creak and a small low thump

picker-select.prompt: Spur jingle as boots shift weight, then a rope coil sliding through a gloved hand

picker-move.prompt: Two unhurried boot steps on dry sand, each with a faint spur ring

picker-capture.prompt: Lasso twirl whoosh, the rope tip cracks, pulled taut with a creak, then a soft thud on sand

picker-hop-multi.prompt: Three springy cartoon hops rising in pitch, each landing with a light tap on sand, then a final spur jingle

rakaeli-select.prompt: Folded feathered wings stir with a soft feather rustle under the faint glassy ring of a cracked halo

rakaeli-move.prompt: Two soft feathered wing flaps, the second lighter, then a quill settles

rakaeli-capture.prompt: A pale strike: a quick feather-edged slash of air, a cold glass-like impact with a soft low body, and a falling eerie halo sigh

rakaeli-skill.prompt: Dark transformation: rising sizzle and flare whoosh, a glass halo snaps, two big accelerating wing strokes as a dark choir swells, and a crimson flame bloom

rakaeli-awake-move.prompt: One heavy flaming wing beat: a deep downstroke whump with fire roaring along the wing and a few embers crackling

rakaeli-awake-capture.prompt: Dark flame impact: air sucked inward, a heavy blow with a low out-of-tune bell strike, a fire bloom and a trail of embers

rakaeli-awake-end.prompt: Flames die back: last embers pop and thin out, smoke leaves in a soft breathy exhale, then a single faint halo ring returns

rampid-select.prompt: Quick ice skate stop with a spray of shaved ice and a sparkle of frost

rampid-move.prompt: Two fast ice skating strides, bright blade carves, and a short glide hiss

rampid-capture.prompt: Speed dash into an icy hit: fast rising rush, glassy ice shatter strike with a small low body, shards scattering, frost crackling

larhen-select.prompt: Twin daggers drawn one after the other, two crisp steel shings, the second a touch higher, in a quiet dry space

larhen-move.prompt: A high leap: a coat flick, air rushing past, and a near-silent light landing

larhen-capture.prompt: Two lightning-fast dagger cross slashes with a crisp steel tsing on the cut, then silence

volkonov-select.prompt: A quick friendly rolled lute strum in a major key and a playful little high plucked answer

volkonov-move.prompt: Two light lute plucks stepping up a fourth with a soft cloak swish under them

volkonov-capture.prompt: Lute flourish: a fast run down the scale, a snapped low string thwack on the body and a sly resolving high note

volkonov-skill.prompt: Accelerating rising major arpeggio of lute plucks over a warm swelling chorused pad, crowned by a bright two-note chime and a sparkle

verish-select.prompt: Power boots start up: a quick servo spin-up whine, two small electric ticks and a bright rising two-note ready ping

verish-move.prompt: Fast power-boot slide: a thrust whoosh, a dropping whine as she glides, and an electric skid with arc crackle

verish-capture.prompt: A punchy pierce: one strong impact as she shoots through the target, a burst of static where the boots strike, air rushing closed behind

verish-hop-multi.prompt: Three rapid pierce impacts rising in pitch over one rising zip, a crackling electric discharge and a short skid to a stop

midos-select.prompt: A cold ghostly breath, then metal claws spring out with a snikt, in a hollow dark space

midos-move.prompt: A low ghost glide: a soft rising then falling whoosh of shadow with a breathy tail, no footsteps

midos-capture.prompt: Three quick claw rakes rising in pitch, a steel tsing on the last cut and a deep hollow void thump

midos-skill.prompt: Shadow teleport: air rushing inward as a ghost folds into nothing, a beat of shimmer, then a deep void pop as it bursts out and claws spring

hammont-select.prompt: Two anvil hammer taps, a smith testing his hammer, with forge coals breathing behind

hammont-move.prompt: Heavy boots: two weighty steps and an iron hammer head swinging on its haft

hammont-capture.prompt: Crushing hammer blow: a big swing, the hammer slamming down with a low body and anvil ring, sparks and debris

hammont-skill.prompt: Knock-back: a heave, a booming hit, a whoosh as the enemy flies off, then a skid

venoa-select.prompt: An arrow drawn from a quiver and nocked, the bowstring creaking half-drawn

venoa-move.prompt: Light steps through wet moss and a cloak swish

venoa-capture.prompt: Bowstring twang, an arrow hissing off, a thock into the target and poison fizzing

glacia-select.prompt: A cold breath of wind and a crystalline two-note chime, a falling minor third, aloof and icy

glacia-move.prompt: An ice skate push-off and a long smooth glide across ice

glacia-capture.prompt: A frost slash whoosh and the target shattering like ice, glassy shards

glacia-skill.prompt: Freeze: a rising frost swirl, a freezing crunch as ice locks around the target, and a cold shimmer
